newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Park City School Dist, Utah.

text.p: General Obligation School Building Bonds, Series 1997
Sealed bids for the purchase of $17,550,000 General Obligation School Building Bonds (Utah School Bond Guaranty Program), Series 1997 (the
Education of Park City School District, Summit County, Utah (the

at the offices of Zions Bank Public Finance, the Financial Advisor to the Board, at its address indicated below. The Bonds will be dated March 1, 1997, issuable in fully registered bonds, book-entry only form, in denominations of $5,000 or any natural multiple thereof, not exceeding the amount of each maturity. The Bonds will mature serially on February 1 of each of the years and in the principal amounts as follows:
Year Amount Year Amount Year Amount

Interest will be payable commencing August 1, 1997, and semiannually thereafter on February 1 and August 1 in each year, at a rate or rates not exceeding six percent (6.00%) per annum to be fixed at the time the Bonds are sold. Copies of the OFFICIAL NOTICE OF BOND SALE, the OFFICIAL STATEMENT, bid forms and other related information with respect to the Bonds, being offered subject to the approval as to the legality of Chapman & Cutler, may be obtained from the Financial Advisor to the Board, Zions Bank Public Finance, at 215 South State Street, Suite 700, Salt Lake City, Utah 84111-2336, telephone: (801) 524-2100, FAX: (801) 524-2109.
